summary.goal: Drive on the RIGHT around a connected compact street block and visibly return to THIS starting intersection with yellow hillside buildings ahead-LEFT and red-orange corner building RIGHT, with the same heading. Use the attached starting reference to verify return. Choose every control solely from screenshots; verify actual completed turns, avoid curbs, collisions, traffic and pedestrians. Do not count seeing the landmark from another heading as completion.
summary.control_plan: model-selected sequential segments; legacy decisions use steering pulse fallback
summary.scenario_state_note: Provenance label only; runner does not load this state
summary.resume_note: Visual context only; no actions replayed, no game state loaded or reset. Emulator must already be at the continuation position.
summary.recording_budget_note: Live stored-frame count is a buffered lower bound. Final bursts are at least15 requests where possible; stopped recording can exceed the target.
summary.frames_note: Nominal frame budgets for timed bursts, not delivered frames; recording count measures actual output

capture.name: flow-minute-03
capture.goal: Drive on the RIGHT around a connected compact street block and visibly return to THIS starting intersection with yellow hillside buildings ahead-LEFT and red-orange corner building RIGHT, with the same heading. Use the attached starting reference to verify return. Choose every control solely from screenshots; verify actual completed turns, avoid curbs, collisions, traffic and pedestrians. Do not count seeing the landmark from another heading as completion.
capture.autonomy: Astra chooses every driving control phase. Wrapper only handles reset, recording and export.
capture.measured_duration_source: MP4 container duration reported by FFmpeg
capture.duration_note: Full window recording preserves real elapsed time: 100% during actions and 50% during inference. Native GS capture separately preserves all emulator frames; its fixed-rate playback does not preserve slow motion.
capture.share_encoding: Full MOV ->1024wide30fpsCRF26; original CRF22 and MOV retained

outcome.notes: Curb/traffic bottleneck, rear collision damage, late carjacking/entry interaction; final occupancy uncertain

capability_checks.budget_prompt: ae6d49d supplies target, buffered elapsed lower bound, remaining upper estimate each decision

decision.rationale: Car near right curb, aligned with lane; motion unverified. Clear junction ahead; advance before turning.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Initial approach; 0 turns verified. Next: right at visible cross street ahead.
decision.dynamics_note: Initial motion unverified; baseline is not a motion sample. Front remains short of cross-street mouth; modest straight acceleration then coast to assess clearance and response.

decision.rationale: Near right curb, roughly parallel; advanced toward corner pole. Cross traffic occupies junction ahead; brake.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Approach; 0 turns verified. Right street mouth ahead; yield to crossing cars.
decision.dynamics_note: 35 throttle +25 coast advanced toward pole without appreciable yaw; still close to right curb. Crossing cars now conflict. Brake then handbrake; stopping not yet verified.

decision.rationale: At right-lane curb, slightly angled toward it; little pole-relative travel. Black car crosses ahead; pedestrian right.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Approach; 0 turns verified. Right mouth still ahead; crossing black car blocks entry.
decision.dynamics_note: 15 brake +45 handbrake produced little landmark-relative travel, slight angle change with car close behind-left. Hold position for crossing car; curb and pedestrian constrain right side.

decision.rationale: Stopped tight to right curb, nose angled inward; right door open beside person. Clear forward-left lane space.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; junction ahead. Move off curb, then reassess first right.
decision.dynamics_note: 60 handbrake held position by pole. Person opened right door; player not visibly outside. Brief forward-left correction seeks curb clearance, then brake before junction; yaw response uncalibrated.

decision.rationale: Tight to right curb, nose slightly inward; little pole-relative advance. Mouth ahead; move left within lane.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; first right mouth ahead. Clear curb and reassess crossing traffic.
decision.dynamics_note: 20 left-throttle +25 throttle gave small forward travel, little yaw; curb still close. Increase left phase to30, coast then handbrake; expect greater yaw as speed builds, not confirmed clearance.

decision.rationale: At right curb, angled toward pole; negligible advance again suggests blockage. Rear-left car limits reversing.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; first right mouth ahead. Recover from apparent curb/pole blockage.
decision.dynamics_note: 30 left-throttle barely advanced or yawed: likely front-right blockage. Rear-left car constrains retreat; try30 reverse-right to swing nose left, then hold. Front clearance remains unverified.

decision.rationale: Right-lane curbside; reverse shifted nose left of pole, rear near car. Slight inward heading needs correction.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; right mouth ahead. Nose now left of pole; advance clear before turning.
decision.dynamics_note: 30 reverse-right produced retreat and left yaw; rear now touches or nearly touches following car. Nose visibly left of pole. No more reverse; brief forward-left then straight should open curb clearance.

decision.rationale: Right lane near curb, nearly parallel; advanced past rear car toward pole. Right mouth ahead, crossing now clear.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; first right mouth ahead. Advance beyond near curb/pole before right arc.
decision.dynamics_note: 15 left +30 straight throttle gave clear forward progress, modest left correction; car remains curbside but pole outside body path. Advance straight35 then hold to verify front clears corner before turning.

decision.rationale: Curbside, nearly parallel; no pole-relative advance. Person leans into open driver door; right mouth ahead has traffic.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; first right mouth ahead. Driver-door interaction now threatens occupancy; crossing traffic present.
decision.dynamics_note: 35 throttle produced no clear advance versus pole; door interaction may interrupt driving, not just curb blockage. Try straight escape without sweeping toward person; occupancy and front clearance uncertain.

decision.rationale: CJ is outside beside the open driver door; car remains curbside, roughly road-aligned. Re-enter rather than drive.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; still at first junction. CJ pulled outside; re-enter car before continuing.
decision.dynamics_note: Inference showed CJ outside; 40 cross did not drive car. Nearby person is striking CJ, driver door open. Tap enter and release; no driving motion assumed until occupancy is visible.

decision.rationale: CJ remains outside; car is stationary at right curb, road-aligned. Attacker stands between CJ and open door.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; still at first junction. CJ outside; vehicle entry unconfirmed.
decision.dynamics_note: 1-frame triangle plus59 released frames left CJ outside, with camera shifted; entry may be interrupted by attacker. Release for this decision to avoid toggling entry; car remains fixed by junction.

decision.rationale: CJ outside beside attacker; car still fixed at right curb, roughly road-aligned, driver door open. Retry entry.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; first junction, CJ outside. Retry entry into stationary car.
decision.dynamics_note: 60 released frames left CJ outside under attack; car did not move against road markings. Prior1-frame entry failed; try12-frame press then release, verifying occupancy before throttle.

decision.rationale: CJ is moving toward the open door; car remains curbside, roughly road-aligned, without landmark-relative advance.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns verified; still first junction. CJ approaching open door; entry not yet confirmed.
decision.dynamics_note: 12-frame triangle plus48 release moved CJ toward driver door; occupancy remains unconfirmed. Car still fixed beside junction. Allow entry animation without another toggle or throttle.
